source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Ok. Let's go with this design. It still keeps alive the DJ Turntables vibe. Let's make the pour spot should be facing the baristas. I want the buttons to be functional and work. Let's try and make it as splash free as possible. Keep the words on the machine the same. Green accents. The only difference is I want it to say "Karla's Matcha Mixer". From the side view I like the thickness of the machine. I want deep matcha wells but I don't want the box to be too big.

value_updates.size_constraint: deep wells within a compact, not overly large enclosure

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
I actually prefer the smaller bowl size like in the earlier design.

I don’t mind refilling — I want to prioritize:
• better mixing quality
• consistent foam
• faster visual cycles during events

So I’d lean toward a smaller capacity per bowl rather than going up to 8qt.
8 qt's would look like the attached picture. The size of the bowl takes away from the design and the aesthetic. I don't mind refilling. Let's go with a smaller bowl size. One that is the same size as the earlier pictures.

value_updates.size_reference: same size as the bowls in the earlier design pictures

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Also, I want to go with the color beige for the design. The bowl size here is fine.

value_updates.size_reference: bowl size shown in the design accompanying this message
